title: Faster RPR and RCR Permutations
summary: Explicit constructions with small RPR/RCR are known, but it remains open whether substantially faster permutations can be devised.

formal_statement.body: Construct faster-than-linear RPR permutations and faster-than-polynomial RCR permutations.

scope.domain: Permutation constructions for randomized preimage and collision resistance in symmetric cryptography.
parameters: RPR implementation speed: faster than linear
RCR implementation speed: faster than polynomial
scope.unresolved_remainder: Devise permutations with faster-than-linear RPR and faster-than-polynomial RCR.

progress.summary: The paper presents explicit constructions with small RPR/RCR, then identifies substantially faster constructions as an interesting research direction.
citation_labels: Yevgeniy Dodis et al., Indifferentiability of Confusion-Diffusion Networks
